content.comment_body: Is it possible to modify UP/Down counter parameters externally? I need the Off parameter to be adjustable via a variable. EDIT: Possible solution: Using references: How can you set up references between blocks in [product_name]? It should also be feasible by using Variable Memory (Tools -> Parameter VM Mapping).
There are several options: 1. Change the value using the display and message text. 2. Use another counter and reference its value. 3. Adjust via the web server.

Thread closed as the question was posted twice. The related discussion with the subject 'Is it possible to read values from Modbus and use them to modify the Off parameter of the Up/Down counter only under certain conditions?' is available within the conference [product_name] - Software. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to dynamically adjust the 'Off' parameter of an UP/DOWN counter in [product_name] software from outside the block. There is some uncertainty about which interfaces or tools support this, suggesting possible gaps in documentation or ease-of-use regarding external parameter management and variable mapping. Other participants suggested methods like using the display, referencing, and web server, reflecting that the process may be complex or not clearly documented.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to set counter parameters flexibly from external sources or variables, ideally via an intuitive interface or dedicated function within [product_name] software.
